name: Question 9
problem:
Change the order of integration in the following integral, 

$$
{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{2}}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{2}}{\int }_{{y}^{3}}^{2}f(x,y,z)\,dz\,dy\,dx.
$$

so that it is integrated first with respect to $y,$ then $z,$ then $x.$
